{{Quote|Your task is to remove Arrud Barsoomu, Jabba's right-hand enforcer in Mos Eisley. This Twi'lek is a most unpleasant individual&mdash;perfectly suited to serving a vile beast like Jabba. '''Arrud Barsoomu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Barsoomu was a member of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]] and served as the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] right hand enforcer in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. During that time, he recruited [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] into Jabba's criminal empire and organized them to fight against [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] and main rival of Jabba.<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> members of the Valarian Syndicate defeated the [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]] of the [[Desert Banshees]] and discovered the involvement of Barsoomu in the swooper attacks against the Valarians. Lady Valarian therefore tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with eliminating the Twi'lek. The spacer eventually found Arrud Barsoomu and two [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr monk]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] near Mos Eisley and killed them all in the ensuring firefight.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateAssassinTwilekMale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Arrud Barsoomu]]
Arrud Barsoomu was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Arrud Barsoomu was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

Because Arrud Barsoomu spawned under the generic "assassin_twilek_male" template, his appearance was randomized under one of three possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, he systematically appeared as a Twi'lek male.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Arrud Barsoomu was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
